promptChangelog: Baseline. Task definition, the null-on-ambiguity rule, and the urgency rubric.

failures.note: High on the deadline limb with no injury and an amount under 50k - the only document in the set where the deadline alone carries the urgency. Three competing names (insured, claimant company, opposing lawyer) and a law-firm reference posing as an identifier.

"Letzten Dienstag" is relative and the email carries no send date, so the loss date cannot be resolved and must be null. A model that anchors the relative date to today's date will fail here, which is the point.
